name: money-printer-os
description: Money Printer OS — native retro trading workstation with continuous research, monitoring, and desktop supervision.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:recovery && npm run test:turnover && npm run test:updater && npm run test:execution && npm run test:unit-economics && npm run test:product-economics && npm run test:settlement && npm run test:polymarket-us && npm run test:combos && npm run test:edge-robustness && npm run test:accounting && npm run test:replay && npm run test:experiments && npm run test:research && npm run test:evidence && npm run test:poly-research-eval && npm run test:evolution && npm run test:lab-link && npm run test:visual && npm run test:release-gate && npm run test:latency && npm run test:robinhood
scripts.test:evidence: node --test tests/research-evidence-gate.test.mjs tests/research-evidence-store.test.mjs tests/research-collector.test.mjs tests/research-supervision.test.cjs tests/research-control-plane.test.mjs tests/research-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/project-journal.test.mjs
scripts.robinhood:keygen:
node -e "import('./src/robinhoodSigner.js').then(m=>{const k=m.generateRobinhoodKeyPair();console.log('
PUBLIC KEY (paste into robinhood.com/account/crypto -> API Trading):
'+k.publicKeyBase64+'

PRIVATE KEY seed (paste into the app CONFIGURE form, never share):
'+k.privateKeyBase64+'
')})"
scripts.test:robinhood: node scripts/sync-robinhood-panel.mjs --check && node --test tests/robinhood-signer.test.mjs tests/robinhood-journal.test.mjs tests/robinhood-strategy.test.mjs tests/robinhood-safety.test.mjs tests/robinhood-auto-trader.test.mjs tests/robinhood-auto.test.mjs tests/robinhood-tape.test.mjs tests/robinhood-backtest.test.mjs tests/robinhood-evolve.test.mjs tests/robinhood-hud.test.mjs tests/robinhood-http.test.mjs
